notes.title: Voice Chat fixed
notes.content:
3D Voice chat system was fully reworked and all problems should be fixed.
You can now hear your voice in the tutorial for example, or speak with other players in the play map.

notes.title: ACT On Discord
notes.content:
Join ACT's Official Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/34gzCJ6]Click here to join ACT's Official Discord[/url]
